name: Dublikat
source:
The main character is a representative of the numerous Semen tribe.
Like everyone else, he lives in the same house with a counselor, like everyone else, he is greeted by Slavya at the beginning of each cycle.
Most of all, he wants to learn to forget the cycles he has lived.
Unfortunately, he has no choice, but he can no longer continue to live like this.
translation:
主角是众多Semen部落的代表。
和其他人一样，他和辅导员住在同一所房子里，和其他人一样，斯拉维亚在每个周期开始时都会迎接他。
最重要的是，他想学会忘记他所经历的循环。
可惜，他别无选择，但他不能再继续这样生活了。
